subject.title: Feature Request: Cross-platform migration tool (migrate export/import)

question: Should OpenClaw core own automated same-product archive import/restore for machine migration, and if so should it live under `migrate export/import` or the backup command family?
rationale: The answer controls CLI namespace, destructive write behavior, archive trust, credential/session portability, and whether overlapping backup work should proceed in core or remain user-driven.

options.title: Use backup-first migration
options.body: Add platform-targeted backup output or `backup convert` plus better restore docs while keeping final restore user-driven until the trust model is stronger.

options.title: Approve native import
options.body: Implement a preview-first core import/export workflow with explicit trust prompts, canonical path checks, conflict handling, rollback, and security-focused tests.

options.title: Defer to broader backup work
options.body: Keep this issue as product context while the broader backup/restore tracker and encrypted snapshot PR decide whether restore belongs in core.

recommendation.title: Use backup-first migration
recommendation.body: Add platform-targeted backup output or `backup convert` plus better restore docs while keeping final restore user-driven until the trust model is stronger.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior PR discussion shows gumadeiras made the clearest backup-overlap and automated-restore security call, and CONTRIBUTING lists them for CLI work.
